decisions.reason: The Demeter yogurt is a low-cost extension of an established, popular range that uses existing production and supplier relationships, so keeping this option open costs little while its prospects remain favorable.
Launched only in 2024 and shown on its own web page, the mild sliced cheese is too new for its value to be judged, and keeping it costs little given in-house cheesemaking, so the option stays open.

The sliced butter cheese is a recent, closely related line extension with active web presence, and there is not yet enough evidence of failure to justify abandoning an option that is cheap to maintain.
